latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of read-only-workspace-audit.

- Audits imported Campus Copilot workspace snapshots for export-readiness or cited AI/MCP use.
- Strictly read-only: operates only on static snapshots or exported artifacts.
- Provides inspection of open items, evidence location, and snapshot sufficiency.
- Toolchain guidance and example integrations included.
- Ensures snapshot data isn’t falsely equated with live session state.
- Designed for local, audit-trail-focused validation workflows.
